dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Symmetrical and gradual 2D geometric narrowing from the mid-dorsal region toward the posterior peduncle.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: High-intensity mature white across the entire visible dorsal surface.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Small, dark, linear vertical mark located on the left side of the dorsal surface, approximately midway down the visible body length.
high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.dorsal_surface_indentations: Prominent, continuous central dorsal ridge with no visible topological disruptions or shadow-casting depressions.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Single thin linear scar or mark on the left side of the dorsal ridge.
